taglineZh: 无障碍树快照加 ref 编号定位，让 Agent 精准操作网页
taglineEn: Accessibility-tree snapshots with refs for precise agent-driven web actions
descZh: 面向 AI Agent 的无头浏览器命令行工具。先用 snapshot 拿到带 ref 编号的无障碍树，再用 click、fill 按编号操作元素，不靠截图猜坐标。适合多步网页流程自动化、填表和抓取结构化数据，支持会话隔离与登录态保存。
descEn: A headless-browser CLI built for AI agents. Take an accessibility-tree snapshot to get numbered refs, then click or fill by ref instead of guessing coordinates from screenshots. Fits multi-step web workflows, form filling and structured data extraction, with session isolation and saved login state.
outputZh: 结构化快照与操作结果（JSON）
demoCaptionZh: 终端里的无障碍树快照与 ref 点击、填表操作日志
demoCaptionEn: A terminal showing an accessibility-tree snapshot and ref-based click/fill action log

taglineZh: 经 MCP 调 Chrome DevTools 查性能、网络、乱码与内存问题
taglineEn: Drive Chrome DevTools via MCP for performance, network, a11y and memory debugging
descZh: 把 Chrome DevTools 接成 MCP 工具，供 Agent 直接调试页面：LCP 性能分析、网络与 cookie 检查、无障碍审计、整页截图、内存泄漏定位。页面报错、首屏慢、导出无响应时按症状进对应分册排查，产出诊断结论与修复建议。
descEn: Exposes Chrome DevTools as MCP tools so an agent can debug pages directly: LCP performance analysis, network and cookie inspection, accessibility audits, full-page screenshots and memory-leak diagnosis. Symptom-based playbooks cover page errors, slow first paint and silent export failures, yielding diagnoses and fixes.
demoCaptionZh: 性能面板与网络瀑布图片段，附 LCP 优化审查结论
demoCaptionEn: Performance panel and network waterfall excerpt with an LCP audit verdict

taglineZh: 打印优化 HTML 经 Chrome 无头出 PDF，中文表格都不坏
taglineEn: Print-optimized HTML to PDF via headless Chrome, safe for CJK and tables
descZh: 用打印优化的 HTML 加 Chrome 无头模式生成 PDF 交付物，适合说明书、报告和方案。@page 控制 A4 分页，表格行不跨页断裂，图片 base64 内嵌避免路径问题。生成后做关键词提取和页面渲染核验，不凭感觉说生成好了。
descEn: Produces PDF deliverables from print-optimized HTML through headless Chrome, for manuals, reports and proposals. @page rules control A4 pagination, table rows never split across pages, and images are base64-embedded to avoid path issues. Output is verified by keyword extraction and rendered-page checks.
outputZh: A4 PDF 文档（附源 HTML）
demoCaptionZh: A4 打印排版页面预览，含页眉页脚与导出核验流程
demoCaptionEn: An A4 print-layout page preview with header, footer and an export verification flow

taglineZh: 读写 .canvas 画布文件：节点、边、分组与整数坐标
taglineEn: Read and write .canvas files: nodes, edges, groups and integer coordinates
descZh: 按 JSON Canvas 1.0 规范读写 .canvas 文件，处理 text、file、link、group 四类节点和连线。用于把笔记与想法铺上画布、给工具加画布导入导出。数组顺序即层叠顺序、坐标要取整、颜色是枚举，产出合法的 .canvas 文件与字段说明。
descEn: Reads and writes .canvas files per the JSON Canvas 1.0 spec, covering text, file, link and group nodes plus edges. Use it to lay notes and ideas onto a canvas or add canvas import/export to a tool. Array order is z-order, coordinates must be integers and colors are enums; output is a valid .canvas file with field notes.
demoCaptionZh: 可拖拽节点的迷你画布，右侧实时同步 JSON 坐标
demoCaptionEn: A mini canvas with draggable nodes and live-synced JSON coordinates

taglineZh: 沿数据流八个阶段修中文乱码、SSE 流式与代码块渲染
taglineEn: Fix CJK mojibake, SSE streaming and code rendering across an 8-stage pipeline
descZh: 系统修复 AI 对话前端的展示问题：中文变问号的编码乱码、SSE 不流式、Markdown 不渲染、代码无高亮、公式图表不显示、工具输出泄露。按数据流的 8 个阶段逐段定位，从 tiktoken 解码到 TextDecoder 再到 marked.parse，产出可验证的修复方案与测试用例。
descEn: A systematic fix kit for AI chat frontends: mojibake turning Chinese into replacement chars, non-streaming SSE, unrendered Markdown, missing code highlighting, broken KaTeX/Mermaid and leaked tool output. Traces the 8-stage data pipeline from tiktoken decoding to TextDecoder to marked.parse, delivering verifiable fixes and test cases.
demoCaptionZh: 乱码断裂与正常渲染的修复前后对照，可重放流式输出
demoCaptionEn: Before/after comparison of broken vs fixed rendering, with replayable streaming output

taglineZh: Markdown 转全内联样式，图片上微信图床后推进草稿箱
taglineEn: Markdown to fully inlined HTML, images rehosted on WeChat CDN, pushed to drafts
descZh: 把 Markdown 文章转成可直接发布的公众号成品：样式全部内联以躲过微信剥离，正文图片逐张上传到 mmbiz.qpic.cn 图床，防止发出去裂图。支持生成可粘贴 HTML 或调接口推进草稿箱，推送前卡标题、摘要字数等字段上限。发布始终由人工点击。
descEn: Turns Markdown articles into publish-ready WeChat Official Account content: all styles inlined to survive WeChat's stripping, and every image uploaded to the mmbiz.qpic.cn CDN so nothing breaks after publishing. Either produce paste-ready HTML or push to the drafts box via API, with field-limit checks before pushing. Publishing is always a human click.
outputZh: 公众号 HTML / 草稿箱文章
demoCaptionZh: 手机框内的公众号文章预览与图床替换日志，可切换主题
demoCaptionEn: A phone-framed article preview with CDN upload log and live theme switching
